description: Defines an abstract class ModelTreeAction and its nested subclasses for handling tree-related actions in a widget model, including entity queries, scripting, and service calls within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction
classes.description: Abstract base class for tree actions, providing static methods to read actions from XML and nested subclasses for specific actions.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents an entity query with 'AND' conditions, using ByAndFinder.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents an entity query with specific conditions, using ByConditionFinder.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Represents a script execution action, either inline or external.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service call action, with support for dynamic service names and result handling.

methods.name: readNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML node actions.

methods.name: readSubNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML sub-node actions.
